# optimizelycmp_app (Resource)

An app (an API client registration), written through the API's bulk settings import (experimental). The import matches by name and never deletes, so: callback URLs can be added but not removed (the plan fails if you try), the name cannot change (a new name is a new app), and destroying this resource only stops Terraform managing the app, which stays active in CMP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "optimizelycmp_app" "portal" {
  name         = "Content portal"
  description  = "Our internal content portal"
  homepage_url = "https://portal.example.com"
  expose_email = false

  # URLs can be added but never removed.
  authorization_callback_urls = ["https://portal.example.com/auth/callback"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authorization_callback_urls` (Set of String) OAuth callback URLs (at least one, all https). URLs can be added but not removed.
- `homepage_url` (String) Home page URL. Must be https.
- `name` (String) App name. Changing it creates a new app and leaves the old one in CMP.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `env` (String) Environment. The API only accepted production when tested.
- `expose_email` (Boolean) Whether the API exposes users' email addresses to this app.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The app name (the API gives apps no other identifier).
